title: Scroll-driven animation in CSS: progress, reveals and a sticky media scale
summary: A reading-progress bar on `scroll(root block)` (`scaleX 0 → 1`), section reveals on `view()` with `animation-range: entry 10% cover 35%` (`opacity 0 → 1`, `translateY 3rem → 0`), the hero copy leaving over `exit 0% exit 100%` of a named `--hero` timeline, and one `--rail` view timeline on a `280svh` rail scaling its sticky figure `.55 → 1` over `contain 0% contain 45%`; transform and opacity only, so nothing runs on the main thread; a `@supports (animation-timeline: view())` guard with a scroll-listener and IntersectionObserver fallback that sets the same end states (a top margin of `1000000px` so a jump never strands a block); end states and a `steps(10)` bar under reduced motion
